script.title: Only One Spacecraft Has Ever Visited Neptune
script.description: In 1989, Voyager 2 flew past Neptune and revealed a distant, dynamic ice giant. Today, space telescopes continue to monitor its violent weather and bizarre moons.

shots.narration: Voyager 2 reached Neptune on 25 August 1989, the only spacecraft ever to visit this distant world.
Neptune sits 4.5 billion kilometres from the Sun, where light takes over four hours to reach Earth.
Winds here reach 2,000 kilometres per hour, the fastest speeds measured on any planet in our system.
Voyager saw an Earth-sized storm called the Great Dark Spot, which had vanished when Hubble later looked.
The moon Triton orbits backwards and features active geysers of nitrogen erupting from its surface.
Evidence suggests Triton is a captured world pulled into orbit from the distant Kuiper Belt.
In this remote reach of space, a single year on Neptune lasts 165 Earth years.
